population: The same two-seat Flotilla panel as schedule-changes-cohort.json, all registered slots, both native-completed and sensitivity including graded seat timeouts. No new model calls.
question: Would freezing the already-standing answer when both seats first post the same legal window preserve the eventual reward? Is this genuinely an early event, rather than both happening on the final write?
rules: first time both last posted submissions are legal, whether or not they agree
first time both last posted submissions are legal and normalize to the same window
protocol: Scan submissions in native order. A malformed submission clears that role’s prior choice. Never select a cutoff using grades, other runs, future writes, task keys, or elapsed host times. Keep the native final reward if no checkpoint occurs; label the abstentions. Analyze all matched teams first, then report talk/silent and timeouts separately. Count later recorded writes, not tokens or minutes saved.
test: Only call agreement a lossless early stop ON THIS ARCHIVE if at least one completed team has later writes and the largest possible count of lost successes is zero under all native same-task-consistent keys. Report possible benefit/loss separately and net bounds; otherwise reject or mark unresolved. Independently score every reached prefix with a recovered task key where available. No claim about live cancellation or an LLM changing behavior.
